source.note: "Run a job" (POST /projects/:id/jobs/:job_id/play, "For a job in manual status, trigger an action to start the job"): the example response is a job object with status pending and started_at null. The job is pipelines-manual.json's held sentry-release-commit (id 9073); the runner, user, commit and artifacts members the adapter never reads are removed. S-28.7.

The "Run a job" section documents only the 200 and a 429 for the manual job run rate limit; a job id the project does not have is answered by GitLab's general REST status table, 404 for a resource that could not be found. The body is the table's generic message. S-28.7.

"To run a manual job, you must have permission to merge to the assigned branch", and a protected environment admits only its Allowed to deploy list. The jobs API page does not state the status for an account without that permission; 403 is GitLab's general REST status for an authenticated request the account may not make (https://docs.gitlab.com/api/rest/troubleshooting/). The body is that table's generic message. S-28.7.
